name: Optimization-based Downsampling
definition: A downsampling approach for microflakes volumes that takes into account shadowing effects by iteratively optimizing scattering parameters using large-scale training rendering until the appearance of LoDs matches the reference volume.
summary: Optimization-based downsampling reduces microflake volume resolution by iteratively optimizing scattering parameters to match high-resolution appearance, explicitly accounting for shadowing effects unlike naive averaging.
